title: Если планы изменятся
description: Строим реальные условия о будущем и обсуждаем запасной план поездки.
notes: В реальном условии о будущем: If + Present Simple, will + начальная форма.
Unless означает «если не»; второе отрицание обычно не нужно.

public_payload.sentence: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay indoors.

exercises.explanation: В придаточном с if для реального будущего нужен Present Simple: rains.

exercises.prompt: Дополни главное предложение о возможной задержке.

public_payload.sentence: If the train is late, we ___ call you.

exercises.editorial_answer: If the train is late, we will call you.
exercises.explanation: Will call — ожидаемое действие при реальном будущем условии.

exercises.prompt: Какой смысл у Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus?

options.label: If you hurry, you will miss the bus.
You missed the bus because you hurried.
If you do not hurry, you will miss the bus.

exercises.editorial_answer: If you do not hurry, you will miss the bus.
exercises.explanation: Unless = if not. Это условие будущего, а не сообщение о прошлом.

exercises.prompt: Что группа сделает при отмене лодочной экскурсии?

options.label: They will take the boat even in strong wind.
They will lose all their money.
They will visit the science museum.

public_payload.passage: A group of friends has booked a boat trip for Saturday. The company says the trip will go ahead unless the wind is too strong. If it is cancelled, the group will receive a refund. They have agreed to visit the science museum instead, so the day will not be wasted.

exercises.editorial_answer: They will visit the science museum.
exercises.explanation: Запасной план прямо указан: visit the science museum instead; при отмене будет refund.

public_payload.source: Если я найду билет, я тебе позвоню.

accepted: If I find a ticket, I will call you.
If I find a ticket, I'll call you.

exercises.reference_answer: If I find a ticket, I will call you.
exercises.incorrect_answer: If I found a ticket, I would call you.
exercises.editorial_answer: If I find a ticket, I will call you.
exercises.explanation: Find + will call описывает реальную будущую возможность; found + would меняет тип условия.

options.label: If it cancelled yesterday, we go tomorrow.
If it is cancelled, we can go to the cinema.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: The outdoor concert may be cancelled.

lines.speaker: Lia
lines.text: What shall we do if that happens?

exercises.editorial_answer: If it is cancelled, we can go to the cinema.
exercises.explanation: If it is cancelled задаёт реальное условие; can предлагает возможный вариант действий.

public_payload.sentence: Unless you will leave now, you will be late.

accepted: Unless you leave now, you will be late.

exercises.reference_answer: Unless you leave now, you will be late.
exercises.incorrect_answer: Unless you leave now, you will not be late.
exercises.editorial_answer: Unless you leave now, you will be late.
exercises.explanation: После unless в таком условии нужен Present Simple. Отрицание в главной части изменило бы смысл.

options.label: We will wait unless you call.
If I see Maya, I will tell her.
If I will see Maya, I will tell her.

exercises.editorial_answer: If I see Maya, I will tell her.; We will wait unless you call.
exercises.explanation: После if/unless о реальном будущем используем Present Simple, а не will.
